decision_rule: Lifecycle validation only: full row passes when two fresh distinct server PIDs complete at least one token each and each captured process is proven dead before the next arm; first arm is dedicated spec-type none, has no draft model/flags and sends no speculative.n_max override. Failed sampling, health ownership or cleanup rejects the row. Native qualification emits one real no-draft result only after verified cleanup; it does not establish full pair behavior or throughput/quality claims.
notes: Prepared offline only; owner publishes. Existing 35B GGUF used because historical 27B path is absent. Model header/stat identity verified, no weight digest claim. Fixed 2048 nominal context, 16 max output tokens, no warmups, full row 2 requests; smoke 1 request. Whole-host quiet claim full run. No production source/build/config mutations. Custody hardened: parent-death SIGKILL wrapper, same engine process group, continuous STOP/deadline watchdog. Native smoke pins exactly four CPUs from inherited actual grant affinity and four server threads.
